name: wappie
description: Read-only access to your WhatsApp archive in Wappie: authorized numbers, chats, message metadata and activity.

interface.longDescription: Wappie keeps an end-to-end encrypted archive of the WhatsApp numbers you connect to it. This plugin lets your assistant read that archive through Wappie's hosted connector, after you sign in to the Wappie console and choose which numbers it may read. It is read-only: nothing is ever sent, edited or deleted. On the hosted connector content stays sealed to your own devices, so the assistant sees who, when, how much and what type of message, never the text, names or filenames.
defaultPrompt: Using Wappie, summarize today's WhatsApp activity on my numbers.
